primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with absence of NASH and no worsening of fibrosis on liver histology at Week 52.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 52, endpoint rates were 51.84% (5 mg), 63.13% (10 mg), and 73.92% (15 mg) versus 12.62% with placebo; p<0.001 for each dose versus placebo.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 5/47 (5 mg), 4/47 (10 mg), and 0/48 (15 mg) versus 3/48 with placebo; no deaths.
